name: BTC aggressive-flow absorption state
description: Combines the ten-second signed aggressor flow, ten-second spot-reference return, and current combined five-basis-point depth. flow_to_depth_ratio divides absolute signed base flow by total near-touch base depth. response_bps_per_depth_turn divides absolute ten-second return by that ratio and is defined as zero when the ratio is exactly zero. State is insufficient_flow below a 0.25 depth turn; at or above 0.25 it is absorbing at no more than 1 response basis point per depth turn, price_responsive at or above 3, and mixed between those boundaries. The 0.25, 1, and 3 classification boundaries are initial research thresholds that require empirical calibration. These are measurement classifications, not trading instructions. Ready output requires all three exact upstream signals to be ready. absorption_state carries no move gate: it is ready whenever its three exact upstream signals are ready, independent of any qualifying-move threshold.
